1.title: AI Will Build Most Frontend Code | Guillermo Rauch
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Guillermo Rauch (Vercel CEO) on AI-driven frontend development phases, the "software factory" model for agents, non-developer coding, agent governance, and predictions for the agentic economy.

1.title: 80% of Voters Expect Massive AI Job Losses | David Shor
1.author: MTS
1.hook: David Shor discusses polling data on public perception of AI job losses and existential risk, voter anger over inflation as political backdrop, and what policies voters actually support around AI transition.

1.title: Why AI Agents Need Local Computers | Sarah Sachs
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Notion's Head of AI explains the shift from token-exhaustive LLM loops to CPU execution, local file systems, and deterministic workflows for agents; covers Vercel Workers architecture, model evaluation strategy, and how Notion layers context across frontier models to avoid lock-in.

1.title: AI Agents Are Replacing Human Readers | Han Wang
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Han Wang (Mintlify co-founder) on how AI agents consume documentation differently than humans, what that means for docs infrastructure design, and how developer relations and technical writing roles shift as a result.

2.title: Human Experience Is the Bottleneck on AI | Rudolf Laine
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Rudolf Laine discusses philosophical frameworks for AI alignment (Bentham vs. Mill utilitarianism), the role of human ground-truth as an un-automatable constraint on moral progress, and the concept of "successionism" in AI governance.

1.author: MTS
